preconditions.description: The length of the permutation n is between 1 and 50000, inclusive.
The value of k multiplied by 2 is less than or equal to n.

postconditions.description: The output is a permutation of length 2n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 2 * n for a_i in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output is a positive integer between 1 and 2n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(output[2 * i - 1] - output[2 * i]) for i in range(1, n + 1)) - abs(sum(output[2 * i - 1] for i in range(1, n + 1)) - sum(output[2 * i] for i in range(1, n + 1))) == 2 * k
postconditions.description: The sum of absolute differences between adjacent elements minus the absolute difference between the sum of the first half and the sum of the second half equals 2k.
